newsitem.title: USA: Commonwealth Edison may issue $300 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth Edison may issue $300 mln in debt.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison is expected to issue $300 million in a two-part debt offering on Monday or Tuesday, high-grade syndicate sources said.
The first tranche is expected to consist of $150 million in seven-year debt, with price talk seen between 95 to 100 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, sources said.
The second tranche is expected to consist of $150 million in 10-year debt, with price talk seen at 112.5 basis points over Treasuries, they added.
The deal is expected to be rated Baa3 by Moody's Investors Service Inc and BBB by Standard & Poor's.
Salomon Brothers is expected to underwrite the offering, sources said.
Commonwealth Edison's parent is Unicom Corp.
